have breakfast: I usually have breakfast at seven o'clock before going to school.
我通常七点吃早餐，然后去上学。
have lunch: We often have lunch together in the school dining hall.
我们经常一起在学校食堂吃午餐。
have dinner: My family has dinner at home every evening.
我家每天晚上都在家吃晚餐。
go to sleep: After reading a story, the little girl went to sleep quickly.
听完故事后，小女孩很快入睡了。
come from: Most of the students in our class come from this city.
我们班大多数学生都来自这座城市。
ugh: Ugh, this milk smells terrible; I think it has gone bad.
哎呀，这牛奶闻起来很难闻，我想它变质了。
look at: Look at the blackboard carefully, or you will miss the important points.
认真看黑板，不然你会错过重点。
over there: The bus stop is over there, just across the street.
公交车站在那边，就在街对面。
kilo (= kilogram): She bought a kilo of apples and two kilos of bananas.
她买了一公斤苹果和两公斤香蕉。
as well as: He speaks French as well as English.
他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。
all over the world: People all over the world love watching football games.
全世界的人都喜欢看足球比赛。
be good at: My sister is good at swimming and won a medal last year.
我姐姐擅长游泳，去年赢得了一枚奖牌。
many kinds of: There are many kinds of flowers in the park in spring.
春天公园里有许多种花。
search for: I searched for my keys for an hour but couldn't find them.
我找钥匙找了一个小时，但没找到。
ha ha: Ha ha, that joke you told was really funny.
哈哈，你讲的那个笑话真有趣。
at weekends: At weekends, I often visit my grandparents in the countryside.
周末我经常去乡下看望祖父母。
I'm afraid: I'm afraid I can't come to your party tomorrow evening.
恐怕我明晚不能来参加你的聚会了。
can't = cannot: I can't understand this math problem; could you help me?
我不懂这道数学题，你能帮我吗？
take photos: Tourists like to take photos of the old buildings here.
游客们喜欢在这里给古建筑拍照。
wait for: Please wait for me at the school gate after class.
下课后请在学校门口等我。
on sale: The new phones are on sale in that shop now.
那家商店现在正在出售新手机。
go back: We should go back home before it gets dark.
天黑之前我们应该回家。
hot dog: The boy ate a hot dog and drank some orange juice.
那个男孩吃了一个热狗，喝了些橙汁。
get ready for: The students are getting ready for the final examination next week.
学生们正在为下周的期末考试做准备。
at the moment: I'm busy at the moment, but I can help you later.
我现在很忙，但可以晚点帮你。
at work: My mother is at work now, so she can't answer the phone.
我妈妈现在在上班，所以不能接电话。
put away: Please put away your toys before you go to bed.
睡觉前请把你的玩具收好。
sweep away: The strong wind swept away the leaves on the ground.
大风把地上的落叶扫走了。
programme (AmE program): My favourite TV programme starts at eight every Friday evening.
我最喜欢的电视节目每周五晚八点开始。
Merry Christmas: Merry Christmas! I hope you get lots of presents this year.
圣诞快乐！希望你今年能收到很多礼物。
mm: Mm, this soup smells so good that I want another bowl.
呣，这汤闻起来太香了，我还想再来一碗。
done: Don't worry; the report is almost done, and I'll send it soon.
别担心，报告快做完了，我很快就发给你。
have a try: This cake looks delicious; would you like to have a try?
这蛋糕看起来很好吃，你想尝一尝吗？
sweet tooth: My little brother has a sweet tooth and eats candy every day.
我弟弟爱吃甜食，每天都吃糖。
be proud of …: Her parents are proud of her because she passed the exam easily.
她父母为她感到骄傲，因为她轻松通过了考试。
sb. can't wait: The children can't wait to open their presents on Christmas morning.
圣诞节早晨，孩子们迫不及待地想打开礼物。
at school: My son is at school from eight in the morning to four.
我儿子从早上八点到下午四点都在上学。
first prize: She won the first prize in the English speech contest last month.
上个月她在英语演讲比赛中获得了一等奖。
write about: The teacher asked us to write about our summer holiday plans.
老师让我们写一写我们的暑假计划。
Arabic: Arabic is spoken by millions of people in North Africa and the Middle East.
北非和中东有数百万人讲阿拉伯语。
